text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The decisive battle: the Tenno Sho (Autumn). The day of the race—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how Bubble Gum Fellow will do.
With what happened to Waltz of Shadow, I hope she can keep the momentum going, but—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The Senior division is so stacked this year...!
Sakura Laurel, Mayano Top Gun,
Marvelous Sunday—it's way too star-studded...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text: "If Bubble loses here, it might start a bad trend for the 'Four Heavenly Kings,' so I'm a little worried..."

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
...Just standing by and watching...
It's really frustrating, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"...Right.
Knowing Bubble, though, she'll surely—"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ......Bubble――

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry...
To you... once again, I...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH...—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel like the passion in the venue
is coming through even more than usual today."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And just as much...
the intense presence of the racing Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Around Bubble Gum Fellow dwells an unusual tension
and an intimidating presence unlike her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It surely stemmed from her fierce resolve to win this Tenno Sho (Autumn) for the sake of Waltz of Shadow.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Just for today, it really gets under your skin, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
This race is our one and only stage
to prove our strength, and—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
This is a race where I have to carry on what Waltz entrusted to me
and carve open the future.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I absolutely cannot afford to lose.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it everything I've got.
Like I never have before...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow's words carried a razor-sharp resolve.
The fighting spirit radiating from her whole body was stronger than ever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, that is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "For Waltz's sake as well, we must win the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Part of me worries that the tension dwelling within Bubble Gum Fellow ever since then might cause her to burst—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The strength she needed to prove, and her feelings for her dear friends.
The future she had to forge, and a situation where losing wasn't an option.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There's no denying the possibility that those things
could negatively impact Bubble Gum Fellow's running."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I can do right now as her Trainer.
That is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning "I can't lose" into "I want to win."
It's all about making sure Bubble Gum Fellow can head into the race with her usual strength.
choice_data_list: Today's opponent is undoubtedly a cut above us.
Today's opponent is definitely on another level!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You're right.
choice_data_list: This will undoubtedly be our toughest battle yet.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list: —Still, this isn't the first time you've faced stronger rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That was before I officially signed a contract with Bubble Gum Fellow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've seen her challenge a legendary Triple Crown
Umamusume before her debut, utterly fearless
and giving her all to seize victory—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that very figure is what I still believe,
without a doubt, to be Bubble Gum Fellow's
strongest, truest form...!
choice_data_list: There's only one thing to do today—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I put it into words.
Straightforwardly, filled with trust.
choice_data_list: I'll take on any Senior Uma Musume who comes at me
We'll take on those senior Uma Musume head-on!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list: And... face them head-on and win with your true ability!!
And... face them head-on and win with your true ability!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thrust my fist out to her.
It is undeniably right here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dream of someone who believed more than anyone in the world
that 'Bubble Gum Fellow is the strongest.'

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, my head feels a bit clearer now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
I was getting a bit ahead of myself.
But I'm okay now."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I declare it now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'll challenge everyone in the Senior Class head-on,
and with my absolute strongest running————I'll win!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could feel the tension ease from Bubble Gum Fellow's expression,
and her reliable presence returned—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! Bubble Gum Fellow
isn't being outdone at all...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
She's got some real guts...!
There might actually be a chance here...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(...What immense pressure.
As expected of the Senior Class forefront...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ââEven so, I will win.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (The strongest one today is me...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's go...! 
To carve open the future!!
